args.title: Fix export file name date to match export day
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Adjust the logic for determining the export file name's date to reflect the actual export day as per the user's local time zone.

args.title: Fix duplicate report naming for long names
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Change the duplicated report naming logic to append '(copy)' rather than truncating the name with ellipsis when near the length limit.

args.title: Clear error messages upon file selection
args.body:
File: src/components/FileUpload.tsx

Implement functionality to clear any existing error messages as soon as a new file is selected, preventing confusion for users.
